ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots rock right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits, Vol. 1 and 2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection fits my interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of The Rolling Stones 1964-1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The classic blues-rock sound appeals to me, but I would pass on a compilation this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Second Hand Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Dwight Yoakam's country sound fits my interest in roots music, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essentials; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little information to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not in the mood for funk and soul today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Mamas & the Papas - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Their harmony-led pop is less appealing than guitar-driven music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is the Tedeschi Trucks Band album, its blues and roots sound interests me, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Muddy Wolf at Red Rocks; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: The live blues guitar and Muddy Waters and Howlin' Wolf material strongly fit my current mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Goin' Home; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: If this is Kenny Wayne Shepherd's album, it fits my blues interests, but I would try only one album today.
